name: @pipeworx/mcp-crates

tools.name: search_crates
tools.description: Search crates.io for Rust packages by keyword. Returns crate name, description, downloads, latest version, and repo URL.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: get_crate
tools.description: Get full metadata for a specific crate (e.g., 'serde'). Returns description, downloads, latest version, repo, homepage, and categories.

tools.name: get_versions
tools.description: List all published versions for a crate in reverse chronological order. Returns version number, download count, and publish date.

tools.name: get_crate_dependencies
tools.description: List the dependencies of a specific crate version — what <crate> itself depends on. Returns each dependency with its version requirement, kind (normal/build/dev), optional flag, enabled features, and target. Version is optional (defaults to the latest stable). Use for "what does <crate> depend on", dependency audits, or sizing a crate's footprint.

version.description: Exact version (e.g. "1.40.0"), or omit for the latest stable.

tools.name: get_crate_reverse_deps
tools.description: List crates that DEPEND ON a given crate (reverse dependencies), most-downloaded first — answers "what uses <crate>", "how widely adopted is <crate>", "who depends on <crate>". Returns the total dependent count plus the top dependents with their version requirement, dependency kind, and download counts.

limit.description: Number of top dependents to return (default 20, max 100).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-crates forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the crates pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
